# 市场与拍卖系统 ## 核心概念 游戏内市场系统的工程核心是**价格发现机制**：让买方和卖方通过竞争找到双方都愿意接受的成交价格。不同的市场结构（订单簿、拍卖行、固定价格商店）会产生截然不同的价格动态和玩家行为。 ```mermaid graph TD subgraph 卖方 S1[玩家挂单卖出
Ask Order] S2[NPC 定价出售] end subgraph 撮合引擎 OB[订单簿
Order Book] ME[撮合逻辑
Matching Engine] end subgraph 买方 B1[玩家市价买入
Market Order] B2[玩家限价买入
Limit Order] end S1 & S2 --> OB B1 & B2 --> OB OB --> ME ME --> T[成交记录
Trade] ME --> P[最新成交价
Last Price] ``` | 市场类型 | 价格发现机制 | 适用场景 | 流动性 | 操控风险 | | ------------ | ------------------ | ---------------- | ------ | ------------------ | | 连续双边拍卖 | 订单簿撮合 | 高频交易物品 | 高 | 中（可被操控价格） | | 密封出价拍卖 | 同时提交，开标一次 | 稀有道具首次销售 | 低 | 低 | | 荷兰式拍卖 | 价格递减直到成交 | 限量发行 | 低 | 低 | | 固定价格商店 | NPC 锚定价格 | 基础消耗品 | 极高 | 无 | | 英式拍卖 | 公开递增出价 | 节日限定物品 | 中 | 中（哄抬出价） | ## 订单簿实现 订单簿是连续双边拍卖市场的核心数据结构： ```python from dataclasses import dataclass, field from heapq import heappush, heappop from typing import Optional import time @dataclass(order=True) class Order: price: float timestamp: float = field(default_factory=time.time) order_id: str = field(compare=False) player_id: str = field(compare=False) quantity: int = field(compare=False) order_type: str = field(compare=False) # "buy" | "sell" def __post_init__(self): # 买单按价格降序（最高价优先），卖单按价格升序（最低价优先） if self.order_type == "buy": self.price = -self.price # 反转实现最大堆 class OrderBook: """ 连续双边拍卖订单簿 买单：最高价优先；卖单：最低价优先；同价格则先入先出 """ def __init__(self, item_id: str): self.item_id = item_id self.buy_orders: list = [] # 最大堆（存负价格） self.sell_orders: list = [] # 最小堆 self.trade_history: list[dict] = [] self.last_price: Optional[float] = None def submit_order(self, order: Order) -> list[dict]: """提交订单，尝试撮合，返回成交记录""" trades = [] if order.order_type == "buy": trades = self._match_buy_order(order) if order.quantity > 0: # 未完全成交则入队 heappush(self.buy_orders, order) else: trades = self._match_sell_order(order) if order.quantity > 0: heappush(self.sell_orders, order) return trades def _match_buy_order(self, buy_order: Order) -> list[dict]: """撮合买单：与最低卖价匹配""" trades = [] buy_price = -buy_order.price # 还原真实价格 while (self.sell_orders and buy_order.quantity > 0 and self.sell_orders[0].price <= buy_price): sell_order = heappop(self.sell_orders) trade_qty = min(buy_order.quantity, sell_order.quantity) trade_price = sell_order.price # 以卖单价格成交（价格优先） trade = { "item_id": self.item_id, "price": trade_price, "quantity": trade_qty, "buyer": buy_order.player_id, "seller": sell_order.player_id, "timestamp": time.time() } trades.append(trade) self.trade_history.append(trade) self.last_price = trade_price buy_order.quantity -= trade_qty sell_order.quantity -= trade_qty if sell_order.quantity > 0: # 卖单未完全成交则放回 heappush(self.sell_orders, sell_order) return trades def _match_sell_order(self, sell_order: Order) -> list[dict]: """撮合卖单：与最高买价匹配""" trades = [] while (self.buy_orders and sell_order.quantity > 0 and -self.buy_orders[0].price >= sell_order.price): buy_order = heappop(self.buy_orders) buy_price = -buy_order.price trade_qty = min(sell_order.quantity, buy_order.quantity) trade_price = buy_price # 以买单价格成交 trade = { "item_id": self.item_id, "price": trade_price, "quantity": trade_qty, "buyer": buy_order.player_id, "seller": sell_order.player_id, "timestamp": time.time() } trades.append(trade) self.trade_history.append(trade) self.last_price = trade_price sell_order.quantity -= trade_qty buy_order.quantity -= trade_qty if buy_order.quantity > 0: heappush(self.buy_orders, buy_order) return trades def get_spread(self) -> Optional[float]: """买卖价差（流动性指标）""" if self.buy_orders and self.sell_orders: best_buy = -self.buy_orders[0].price best_sell = self.sell_orders[0].price return best_sell - best_buy return None def get_market_depth(self, levels: int = 5) -> dict: """获取盘口深度""" # 简化实现：实际应聚合同价格订单 buy_side = sorted([(-o.price, o.quantity) for o in self.buy_orders], reverse=True)[:levels] sell_side = sorted([(o.price, o.quantity) for o in self.sell_orders])[:levels] return {"bids": buy_side, "asks": sell_side} ``` ## 实时拍卖变种实现 ### 倒计时拍卖（英式拍卖） ```python import asyncio from datetime import datetime, timedelta class EnglishAuction: """ 英式拍卖（升价拍卖） 特点：公开递增出价，截止时间前最高出价者获得物品 游戏应用：节日限定道具、赛季冠军奖杯拍卖 """ def __init__(self, item_id: str, item_name: str, starting_price: float, reserve_price: float, duration_seconds: int, min_increment: float = 1.0): self.item_id = item_id self.item_name = item_name self.current_price = starting_price self.reserve_price = reserve_price self.end_time = datetime.now() + timedelta(seconds=duration_seconds) self.min_increment = min_increment self.bids: list[dict] = [] self.current_winner: Optional[str] = None self.ANTI_SNIPE_EXTENSION_SECONDS = 30 # 防狙击：最后30秒出价则延长 def place_bid(self, player_id: str, bid_amount: float) -> dict: """玩家出价""" now = datetime.now() if now > self.end_time: return {"success": False, "reason": "拍卖已结束"} min_bid = self.current_price + self.min_increment if bid_amount < min_bid: return {"success": False, "reason": f"出价必须高于 {min_bid:.1f}"} self.bids.append({ "player_id": player_id, "amount": bid_amount, "timestamp": now }) self.current_price = bid_amount self.current_winner = player_id # 防狙击延伸：最后 30 秒出价则延伸截止时间 time_remaining = (self.end_time - now).total_seconds() if time_remaining < self.ANTI_SNIPE_EXTENSION_SECONDS: self.end_time = now + timedelta( seconds=self.ANTI_SNIPE_EXTENSION_SECONDS ) return { "success": True, "new_price": self.current_price, "end_time": self.end_time.isoformat(), "you_are_winning": True } def finalize(self) -> dict: """拍卖结束，确定结果""" if self.current_price < self.reserve_price: return {"sold": False, "reason": "未达到保留价"} return { "sold": True, "winner": self.current_winner, "final_price": self.current_price, "total_bids": len(self.bids), "reserve_price_met": True } ``` ### 密封出价拍卖 ```python class SealedBidAuction: """ 密封出价拍卖（一价） 特点：所有玩家同时提交出价，出价最高者获胜并支付出价金额 注意：非激励相容，玩家有动机低报以避免赢家诅咒 """ def __init__(self, item_id: str, deadline: datetime): self.item_id = item_id self.deadline = deadline self.sealed_bids: dict[str, float] = {} # player_id -> bid def submit_bid(self, player_id: str, bid: float) -> dict: if datetime.now() > self.deadline: return {"success": False, "reason": "投标已截止"} if player_id in self.sealed_bids: return {"success": False, "reason": "已提交过投标，不可修改"} self.sealed_bids[player_id] = bid return {"success": True, "message": "密封投标已记录"} def open_bids(self) -> dict: """开标""" if not self.sealed_bids: return {"winner": None} winner_id = max(self.sealed_bids, key=self.sealed_bids.get) winner_bid = self.sealed_bids[winner_id] second_price = sorted(self.sealed_bids.values(), reverse=True) second = second_price[1] if len(second_price) > 1 else 0 return { "winner": winner_id, "payment": winner_bid, # 一价：支付自己的出价 "winners_curse_premium": winner_bid - second, "all_bids": dict(sorted(self.sealed_bids.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)) } ``` ## 流动性管理与 NPC 做市商 市场流动性不足时，NPC 做市商可以作为兜底机制： ```python class NPCMarketMaker: """ NPC 做市商：为低流动性物品提供买卖报价 适用场景：冷门道具、稀有材料、赛季早期市场 """ def __init__(self, item_id: str, fair_value: float, spread_pct: float = 0.05): self.item_id = item_id self.fair_value = fair_value self.spread_pct = spread_pct # 买卖价差比例 self.inventory = 100 # NPC 库存 def get_quotes(self) -> dict: """返回 NPC 当前买价和卖价""" bid = self.fair_value * (1 - self.spread_pct / 2) ask = self.fair_value * (1 + self.spread_pct / 2) return {"bid": bid, "ask": ask, "inventory": self.inventory} def update_fair_value(self, recent_trades: list[float]): """根据近期成交更新公允价值""" if recent_trades: self.fair_value = sum(recent_trades) / len(recent_trades) ``` ## 小结 - 订单簿（Order Book）是连续双边拍卖的核心，买单最高价优先，卖单最低价优先，同价则先入先出 - 买卖价差（Spread）是市场流动性的直接指标：价差越小，流动性越好 - 英式拍卖需要防狙击机制（Sniping Protection）——最后时刻出价应延伸截止时间 - 密封出价拍卖（一价）存在赢家诅咒，玩家会策略性低报；Vickrey 拍卖（二价）解决这个问题 - NPC 做市商是低流动性市场的工程兜底，通过提供两侧报价保障市场基本运转
